description: Read and write Velog (velog.io), Korean dev blog. Diagrams, sequences. Public publishing is opt-in.
name: io.github.milcho0604/velog

environmentVariables.description: Velog access token. Either token enables writing; this one expires sooner.
environmentVariables.name: VELOG_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Velog refresh token. Either token enables writing; this one lasts 30 days.
environmentVariables.name: VELOG_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow public publishing. Off by default; the model cannot set this.
environmentVariables.name: VELOG_ALLOW_PUBLIC

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow editing profile fields. Reading the profile always works.
environmentVariables.name: VELOG_ALLOW_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a local Chrome binary, used for diagram, sequence, and cover rendering.
environmentVariables.name: VELOG_CHROME_PATH

title: Velog
